segments.text: WHen the time of their Purificacion (after the law of Moſes) was come, they broughte hym to Ieruſalem, to preſente hym to the Lorde (as it is written in the lawe of the Lorde: euerye manne childe that firſte openeth the matrix, ſhalbe called holye to the Lord:) and to offer (as it is ſayde in the law of the lord) a payre of turtle Dooues, or two young Pigions. And beholde, there was a man in Hieruſalem, whoſe name was Simeon. And the ſame man was iuſt and godly, and loked for the conſolation of Iſrael, and the holy goſt was in him. And an aunſwere had he receiued of the holy goſte, that he ſhould not ſee death, except he firſt ſaw the Lordes Chriſt. And he came by inſpiracion into the temple.
